created: Created. Give people access under <grants>Access › Grants</grants>.
unprotectBody: Deleting it, and a retention that expires its tables, become possible.
propertiesNote: Properties are set when an environment is created through the REST API (properties of POST /api/v1/environments); they cannot be changed afterwards.
incomplete: Some sizes are not measured yet; the worker measures them in its next sweeps.
storageIntro: Where the tables' files are and which secret opens them. The root cannot be changed.
storageProtected: The storage of a protected environment cannot be changed. Unprotect it first.
